Tinkatink

Fairy Steel

Paldea · Generation 9

Tinkatink is a Fairy/Steel-type Metalsmith Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 8.9 kg. It evolves into Tinkatuff. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (64), with a base stat total of 297.
